How many GUI toolkits have learned from those lessons? And Morphic/Smalltalk was cross-platform before Java, in ways Java isn't to this day. It seems to me what hampers evolution is the technology we choose (Java, C) and not the problem itself (drawing interactive elements on the screen).

For anyone interested in this discussion I recommend Alan Kay's "The Computer Revolution hasn't happened yet": [link]
